channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Rainbow Wahine survive in OT to advance to Big West semifinals
item.description: HENDERSON, NEV. >> The Hawaii women’s basketball team scored all 11 points in overtime to defeat Cal State Fullerton 72-61 today and advance to a semifinal Friday against top seed UC Irvine in the Big West Tournament.

item.title: Senate again deadlocks on Homeland Security funding as shutdown persists
item.description: WASHINGTON >> The congressional impasse over funding the Department of Homeland Security is entering its second month after the Senate today again deadlocked over providing money for the agency, even as airports continued to experience security line backups.

item.title: Hawaiian Electric urges customers to prepare for storm-related outages
item.description: Hawaiian Electric is urging customers to prepare for extended power outages as a powerful Kona storm system travels across the islands.

item.title: State and city offices, UH campuses, public schools to close Friday
Rivian unveils $58K R2 launch SUV, deliveries to begin this spring
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO >> Rivian will begin delivering its more affordable R2 line of SUVs this spring with a variant priced at $57,990 and roll out cheaper options by 2027, as the electric vehicle maker looks to widen its customer base and take on Tesla’s best-selling Model Y.

item.title: UH cancels or postpones athletic events Friday due to storm
item.description: With stormy weather expected to worsen Friday, the University of Hawaii has canceled or rescheduled a handful of athletic events slated for the next two days.

item.title: Here’s a list of state and county closures, and emergency shelters
item.description: Hawaii state and county officials announced the following closures and cancellations, as well as emergency shelters opening during this week’s Kona-low storm. This list will be updated as more information becomes available.

item.title: Magnitude 4.4 quake shakes Hawaii island’s southeast coast
item.description: A magnitude 4.4 earthquake struck off the Kau coast of Hawaii island late this afternoon.

item.title: HPD seizes gaming machines, cash during raid in Wahiawa
item.description: Honolulu Police Department officers seized multiple gaming machines and cash on Wednesday after executing a search warrant at an illegal gambling establishment on Mala Street in Wahiawa.

item.title: No. 3 Hawaii sweeps Mount Olive in Invitational
item.description: Sophomore opposite hitter Kristin Titriyski had 10 kills and two aces in his first match in nearly two months and No. 3 Hawaii opened the Outrigger Invitational with a 25-18, 25-19, 25-17 sweep of Mount Olive tonight at Bankoh Arena at Stan Sheriff Center.
